description: This PHP class EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator serves as a decorator for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity, providing methods to set employee data and retrieve tax-related state names through the use of services. It encapsulates logic for fetching state names based on stored state codes and interacts with other entities like Employee and services like CountryService.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity, providing methods to enhance its functionality, especially related to tax state information retrieval and employee association.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the associated Employee entity for the tax exemption based on employee number.

methods.name: getTaxState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the tax state based on the stored state code.

methods.name: getUnemploymentState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the unemployment state based on the stored state code.

methods.name: getWorkState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the work state based on the stored state code.
